title: 信息日报 2026-08-25

headline.title: 中国拟修法建立自动驾驶汽车道路交通安全制度
headline.summary: 道路交通安全法修订草案25日提请十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议审议。草案拟建立自动驾驶汽车道路交通安全制度，对‘盲驾’、‘暴走团’等行为明确治理措施，并将电动自行车在非机动车道上的最高时速从15公里调整为20公里。草案还要求电动自行车驾乘人员佩戴安全头盔。
headline.title_en: China Moves to Establish Road Safety Rules for Self-Driving Cars
headline.summary_en: The draft amendment to China's Road Traffic Safety Law was submitted on Aug. 25 to the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee. It proposes a legal framework for autonomous driving road safety, measures against distracted driving and unauthorized road-use group activities, and raises the e-bike speed limit in non-motorized lanes from 15 to 20 km/h. It also mandates helmets for e-bike riders and passengers.
headline.original_title: 中国拟修法建立自动驾驶汽车道路交通安全制度
headline.reason: 该立法首次在国家层面系统规范自动驾驶汽车，直接影响未来智能交通与AI技术落地，同时回应民众出行安全关切，是当天最具政策影响力的新闻。
headline.reason_en: This is the first national-level legislative attempt to regulate autonomous vehicles, directly affecting future smart mobility and AI deployment while addressing public safety concerns, making it the day's most policy-significant story.
